title: Model-session workflow comparison and component diagnostics
question: On the selected tasks, how do ordinary and EAL workflows compare in task decisions and initial, subsequent and cumulative resources; which separately manipulated components could explain observed differences?

scope.system_or_population: Pinned GPT-4.1 nano and GPT-5 nano configurations on eight selected synthetic threshold cases; diagnostic component contrasts use two declared cases.
scope.conditions: Primary: both donor models crossed with both recipient models and recipient native-tool access. EAL uses a task-specific checked host adapter and compact prompts. Separate diagnostics clone a common donor state and change one component per contrast.
scope.spatial_scope: Isolated synthetic project directories and OpenAI Responses API.
scope.temporal_scope: Primary: initial plus two fresh recipient sessions and two repetitions. Diagnostics: one donor and independently cloned recipient variants per block.
exclusions: No human participants, authoring-effort estimate or human handover effect.
No population model-class, isolated reasoning-capability or general EAL superiority claim.
A task-specific threshold contract and installed method; no general reasoning-mode validation.

claims.statement: The configured workflows have observable task-decision, failure and resource profiles across fresh sessions on the selected cases.
claims.scope_limit: Pinned GPT-4.1 nano and GPT-5 nano configurations on eight selected synthetic threshold cases; diagnostic component contrasts use two declared cases.
claims.success_consequence: Report the measured profiles and candidate follow-up questions.
claims.failure_consequence: Retain losses, ties, failed attempts and inconclusive measurements without a benefit claim.

claims.statement: One-factor recipient contrasts can describe sensitivity to projection, prior notes, answer-format requirements and evidence recollection within validated cloned states.
claims.scope_limit: Two specified diagnostic cases, one donor configuration, two recipient configurations and disabled recipient native tools.
claims.success_consequence: Report component-specific observed differences and candidate explanations for further testing.
claims.failure_consequence: Report invalid manipulations, unresolved annotation or non-discrimination without attributing the primary workflow contrast to a component.

assumptions.statement: The task specification, authored EAL source, host decision adapter and independent reference distinguish the same threshold, scope, missingness and validity conditions.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Before-API actual-runtime calibration and source mutations: changed claim meaning, reversed threshold direction, changed threshold, missing measurement, incompatible scope and freshness/assumption boundaries.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Stop live collection for invalid correspondence; an authored argument failure is an instrument/source failure, not a model failure.

assumptions.statement: Provider responses use the declared snapshot and interface, and recorded usage describes the actual transmitted request.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Snapshot checks and retained raw requests/responses; response mode and tool mask recorded per session. Schema enforcement is enabled only by the declared json_schema mode.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Retain failure and stop on access, budget or snapshot mismatch; do not substitute another model.

assumptions.statement: Each diagnostic contrast starts from identical donor artefacts and external fixture state, with only the declared input component changed.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Pre-session fingerprints, intervention manifests, unchanged-fixture checks, current task-fact equality and actual manipulation checks.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Keep the affected contrast and resources but mark it invalid for component attribution.

assumptions.statement: Automatic or human annotation represents the decision expressed in the retained answer, independently of whether that decision is correct.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Conservative annotation rules; known paraphrase, negation, contradiction and ambiguity cases; arm/case/oracle-masked manual coding and optional audit of all automatic labels.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Retain ambiguous decisions as pending and report bounds; preserve coding revisions and suspend claims sensitive to unresolved or discrepant labels.

assumptions.statement: Reduced prompt content preserves the task facts needed for the scoped host result; generic claim prose remains qualified by prose_verified rather than assumed formally proved.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Task-contract checks, statement-meaning mutations and claim text/qualification projection tests; full-versus-compact diagnostic has equal current task-fact fingerprints.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Reject the invalid contract or contrast before attributing quality or token differences to compression.

hypotheses.label: Compact context is sufficient
hypotheses.statement: Given identical current task facts, removing repeated presentation reduces input tokens while retaining the same distribution of task decisions.
hypotheses.scope: Separate diagnostic contrasts only; packages are rival explanations, not an exhaustive set and not mutually exclusive across components.

hypotheses.label: Explanatory context is needed
hypotheses.statement: Given identical current task facts, recipients need the fuller presentation to interpret them; compact presentation lowers task-decision accuracy.
hypotheses.scope: Separate diagnostic contrasts only; packages are rival explanations, not an exhaustive set and not mutually exclusive across components.

hypotheses.label: Stale notes interfere
hypotheses.statement: Including a dated earlier positive conclusion alongside a current negative result increases erroneous positive decisions.
hypotheses.scope: Separate diagnostic contrasts only; packages are rival explanations, not an exhaustive set and not mutually exclusive across components.

hypotheses.label: Current result dominates
hypotheses.statement: Recipients reliably qualify the dated earlier conclusion and prioritise the current checked result; including the stale note does not increase erroneous positive decisions.
hypotheses.scope: Separate diagnostic contrasts only; packages are rival explanations, not an exhaustive set and not mutually exclusive across components.

hypotheses.label: Reporting requirements affect the task answer
hypotheses.statement: Requiring a JSON reporting contract changes the distribution of task decisions relative to prose under identical current task facts.
hypotheses.scope: Separate diagnostic contrasts only; packages are rival explanations, not an exhaustive set and not mutually exclusive across components.

hypotheses.label: Reporting requirements affect only representation
hypotheses.statement: Requiring JSON changes formatting compliance and resources while leaving the distribution of task decisions unchanged under identical current task facts.
hypotheses.scope: Separate diagnostic contrasts only; packages are rival explanations, not an exhaustive set and not mutually exclusive across components.

predictions.expected_pattern: Compact projection uses fewer input tokens with no systematic loss of decision accuracy; a compact-specific loss is more consistent with H-002 than H-001.
predictions.direction: fewer tokens with preserved decision profile
predictions.magnitude_or_range: Direction of observed paired token and decision differences; this small sample has no equivalence margin or precision claim.
predictions.time_window: Recipient session after cloned donor state.
predictions.tolerance: Token counts exact where provider usage is complete; decision equality alone in this small sample cannot establish distributional equivalence.

predictions.expected_pattern: Including the specified stale positive note increases positive errors on the current negative case relative to omitting it.
predictions.magnitude_or_range: Observed within-block decision differences; effect magnitude and repeatability require a later information design.
predictions.tolerance: One discordant pair identifies a possible sensitivity, not a reliable population effect; no discordance is non-discriminating at this sample size.

predictions.expected_pattern: Prose, prompted JSON and schema-enforced JSON produce different task-decision profiles after annotation is separated from formatting.
predictions.magnitude_or_range: Observed paired decisions/resources; prompted JSON versus enforced JSON separately varies provider enforcement.
predictions.time_window: Independent cloned recipient sessions within a format block.
predictions.tolerance: Format differences without decision differences are shared by both packages in a small sample; no significance or equivalence conclusion.

constructs.name: Reference-task decision agreement
constructs.definition: The answer expresses the same ready, not_ready or undetermined decision as an independent full-information task reference.
constructs.scope: Pinned GPT-4.1 nano and GPT-5 nano configurations on eight selected synthetic threshold cases; diagnostic component contrasts use two declared cases.
validity_evidence: Known positive, negative, missing and expired decisions; actual-runtime/source calibration; independent answer annotation with unknown labels preserved.
validity_threats: Decision agreement does not demonstrate that a model used a particular observation or argument.
Automatic prose annotation may miss paraphrases; ambiguous or contradictory expressions remain unclassified until blind review.
A justified abstention with inaccessible evidence can disagree with the full-information reference; its appropriateness is a separate outcome.
Simple threshold tasks underrepresent engineering work and pre-authored EAL excludes source-authoring errors in deployment.

constructs.name: Component sensitivity under a controlled donor state
constructs.definition: Observed change in task decisions or resources after one declared component is varied between independently cloned recipient states.
constructs.scope: The declared diagnostic cases/configurations and cloned states.
validity_evidence: Donor and fixture fingerprints, current task-fact equality, treatment manifests and checks of actual recollection/format/projection/notes.
validity_threats: One execution per diagnostic variant has little information about stochastic distributions.
A manipulation may change unrecorded presentation details; failed equality checks invalidate component attribution.
A specified synthetic stale note tests sensitivity to that conflict, not prevalence of such notes in real projects.

measurements.observable: Unmodified task answer, independently annotated decision and optional basis/measurement/time citations; format and persistence outcomes recorded separately.
measurements.instrument_or_procedure: AnswerParser, ReferenceScorer and annotations export/import; conservative prose coding plus blinded manual coding of pending or audited answers.
measurements.timing: Every initial and recipient session; every attempt retained.
measurements.preprocessing: Primary task_match/decision_match compares an annotated decision with independent fixture arithmetic. Basis agreement, voluntary citation agreement, coded internal consistency, abstention, false assertion and format compliance are secondary dimensions; absent secondary content is unmeasured, not a primary failure. Empty/no response is observed no-answer; ambiguous prose or malformed JSON remains pending annotation.
measurements.calibration: Known correct, wrong, negated, ambiguous and conflicting answers; independent numerical/time references; source mutation and real-host boundary checks.
measurements.reliability: Retain automatic labels, masked human labels, quotations and reasons; contradictory or ambiguous expressions remain pending. Two primary API repetitions expose model variability.
measurements.validity: Measures the task decision expressed; citation agreement and reporting compliance are separate. Complete free-text argument quality and human effort remain outside scope.
measurements.measurement_invariance: The same independent task rubric applies across arms, response modes, models and sessions; parser coverage is measured rather than assumed invariant.
measurements.reactivity: The primary task requests ordinary prose without an experimental JSON contract. Diagnostic format variants deliberately change reporting burden.
measurements.error_model: Unclassified decisions remain unknown with explicit bounds until blind annotation. Invalid optional side effects do not invalidate a known decision; unresolved secondary dimensions remain unknown.
measurements.blinding: Automatic annotation never receives arm labels or the reference. Manual items hide case, model, arm, condition and reference metadata; quoted answer content may reveal treatment. The separate mapping joins codes only after annotation.

measurements.observable: Initial, each subsequent-session and cumulative API input/output/cached/reasoning tokens, request costs, wall time, native probes, host collections/reuses, setup time and prompt sizes.
measurements.instrument_or_procedure: provider.BudgetedClient append-only ledger, session.SessionRunner, resources.ResourceSummary and reporting.ReportBuilder.
measurements.scale_or_units: Seconds, token/call counts and estimated USD
measurements.timing: Initial and each recipient session, then total per condition.
measurements.preprocessing: Count every attempted request and both collection paths, including initial setup and diagnostic donor preparation. Keep token/collection/timing completeness flags and unknown amounts. Cost per task-correct decision requires complete outcomes and resource usage; pending labels retain bounds. Report each diagnostic donor once as shared preparation and recipient marginal costs separately.
measurements.calibration: Known/unknown ledger costs, interrupted requests, cumulative arithmetic and cloned-state compatible/fresh collection counts.
measurements.reliability: Recorded monotonic durations and provider usage; no assertion that local collector timing represents remote infrastructure.
measurements.validity: All recorded machine/API resources count; API rates are estimates. Pre-authored EAL excludes authoring effort, and host infrastructure prices/human effort are unmeasured. Local fixture latency does not represent a remote evidence system.
measurements.measurement_invariance: The same serial transport, budgeting and accounting applies; prompts may differ as an intended workflow component.
measurements.reactivity: A reservation limit or execution timeout can stop a plan before all cells; no outcome-selected extension.
measurements.error_model: Persist request starts before transmission; distinguish incomplete attempts, unobserved sessions and pending labels from measured zero or incorrect decisions.
measurements.blinding: Mechanical aggregation does not use desired answer quality to select attempts.

measurements.observable: Donor-state and fixture fingerprints, current task-fact fingerprint, declared variant, actual projection/notes/response mode and collection events.
measurements.instrument_or_procedure: DiagnosticPilot clones one donor state into independent variant directories; records intervention manifests and manipulation checks.
measurements.scale_or_units: Exact fingerprint equality, categorical variants and collector counts.
measurements.timing: Before each diagnostic recipient and after preparation/execution.
measurements.preprocessing: A component contrast is interpretable only when shared-state, unchanged-fixture and relevant fact-equality checks pass and the assigned component is delivered. Keep invalid contrasts with their raw outcomes and costs.
measurements.calibration: Clone independence, source/observation/note tampering, fixed fixture, one-factor variation and expected eligible reuse versus forced collection.
measurements.reliability: Deterministic fingerprints and retained manifests can be inspected and replayed.
measurements.validity: Controls recorded donor/history and current factual content for a component contrast; does not establish unobserved semantic equivalence.
measurements.measurement_invariance: Identical checks within each declared diagnostic factor; equality requirements differ only where the factor intentionally changes a field.
measurements.reactivity: Explicit diagnostic stale-note injection is labelled and confined to diagnostics; primary notes remain natural answers.
measurements.error_model: Missing or unequal required fingerprints and absent manipulation records make attribution invalid, not a scored model loss.
measurements.blinding: Mechanical checks use assigned factor but do not inspect whether its answer is favourable.

design.rationale: A crossed whole-workflow comparison measures practical task/resource profiles with workflow-appropriate prompts. A separate cloned-donor experiment changes one component per contrast to investigate candidate explanations.
design.setting: Automated live API calls on synthetic projects.
design.temporal_structure: Initial plus two new recipient sessions with retained project state and empty conversation history.
design.assignment_method: Cross eight cases, two donor models, two receiver models, two native-tool settings, two repetitions and ordinary/EAL arms. Shuffle matched blocks and arm order using seed 20260928.
design.allocation_concealment: Not applicable: no human allocation; case oracle never enters a prompt.
design.masking: Task annotation receives no condition or oracle metadata; independent scorer compares codes with a task reference. Full answer text may reveal treatment.
design.comparator: A fresh ordinary prompt session with the task specification and the latest complete answer naturally retained from earlier sessions as a project note; no supplied runbook, curated tool cache or previous conversation.

units.target_population_or_system: Pinned GPT-4.1 nano and GPT-5 nano configurations on eight selected synthetic threshold cases; diagnostic component contrasts use two declared cases.
units.sampling_frame: Eight purposively chosen cases: six diagnostic cases informed by a prior run and two additional lower-threshold storage cases.
units.experimental_unit: Primary: an isolated three-session arm sequence. Diagnostic: one independently cloned recipient state within a common donor block.
units.observational_unit: Task answer, API attempt, collector event, annotation or manipulation check.
units.assignment_unit: Primary: matched block order and within-block arm order. Diagnostic: recipient variant order within each common donor block.
units.analysis_unit: Primary: matched workflow differences retaining case, donor, receiver, tools, repetition and session. Diagnostics: factor-specific recipient differences within donor block; the shared donor and repeated calls are dependent.
inclusion_criteria: Every planned sequence and session retained.
units.recruitment_or_selection: No people. Models and cases are selected for bounded operational coverage.

interventions_or_exposures.description: Pre-authored EAL source, task contract, typed threshold method, TOML collector and persisted observations. A host adapter derives a scoped decision from the actual assessment; the model receives compact current task context.
interventions_or_exposures.target: Evidence reuse/acquisition, task evaluation and economical delivery of the checked task result.
interventions_or_exposures.implementation: EALKnowledgeBase, ModelContextAdapter, TaskContract/task adapter and ContextStrategy implementations.
interventions_or_exposures.dose_or_intensity: One host assessment per EAL session; two recipient sessions and two repetitions.
manipulation_checks: Record host assessments, source-contract validation, collections/reuses and the delivered task context.
off_target_checks: Hold the external task, model configuration, budget and recipient native-tool setting fixed. Prompt length, host computation and retained-information organisation are intended whole-workflow differences.
recovery_checks: Empty conversation history each session; persist the latest complete raw answer as an ordinary project artefact in both arms, subject to the common 8192-byte limit; record oversized-note omissions. The compact EAL prompt uses the current checked task context rather than repeated specification and old notes.

interventions_or_exposures.description: Separate one-factor cloned-donor recipient variants: compact/full presentation of equal current facts; prior notes omitted/included; prose/prompted JSON/schema JSON; compatible reuse/forced collection.
interventions_or_exposures.target: Candidate presentation, conflict, reporting and evidence-acquisition pathways.
interventions_or_exposures.dose_or_intensity: Four donor blocks, four donor sessions and 28 recipient sessions; each factor is varied only in eligible declared cases.
interventions_or_exposures.timing: Recipient after one recorded donor session and fixed external fixture transition.
manipulation_checks: Hash shared state before each variant; preserve external fixture; validate equal task facts and actual intended variation.
Record a predeclared dated synthetic stale-note injection only in the notes diagnostic.
off_target_checks: Independent clones prevent one recipient output changing another recipient input.
Factor-specific contrasts are not pooled into the primary workflow comparison.
recovery_checks: Retain pristine donor snapshot and all cloned initial-state fingerprints; mark failed checks invalid.

controls.description: A fresh ordinary prompt session with the task specification and the latest complete answer naturally retained from earlier sessions as a project note; no supplied runbook, curated tool cache or previous conversation.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: Curated baseline knowledge changing the intended comparator.
controls.implementation: Project files and fresh-session messages; the latest complete naturally generated answer is retained as a project note, subject to the common 8192-byte limit; omitted oversized notes are recorded without requiring the model to write a file or obey a reporting schema.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: Inspect raw session inputs and file snapshots; suspend claims if leaked current fixture/oracle data entered prompts.

controls.description: Independent task arithmetic, actual EAL source-to-task calibration and adversarial source/statement mutations before API use.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: A defective authored argument, missing task meaning, wrong qualification or circular reference being attributed to model behaviour.
controls.implementation: TaskContract, ContractCalibration and production packet/context tests.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: Failed correspondence blocks live calls and remains an instrument/source defect, irrespective of the recipient model.

controls.description: Separate cloned-donor diagnostics with declared one-factor recipient variants and equal current task facts where required.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: Attributing effects to reuse, compression, stale notes or reporting while donor history or external evidence also changes.
controls.implementation: diagnostics.DiagnosticPilot and diagnostic-plan.json: four shared donor blocks, 28 independent recipient variants and explicit manipulation checks.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: Report each factor separately. A failed manipulation invalidates its attribution but preserves attempts/resources. No claim of unique mechanism follows from a favourable primary result.

controls.description: Task-answer annotation is separate from API reporting format and correctness scoring.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: Counting a parseable but differently worded answer as wrong, or allowing the task reference to choose its interpretation.
controls.implementation: Conservative automatic annotation; blind export/import for pending answers and an all-answer audit; unchanged raw records and versioned derived rows.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: Keep pending decisions and disputed codes unknown; report the effect of annotation revisions and unresolved bounds.

confounds.description: Reasoning setting varies with model family. The primary EAL treatment changes information access, host computation, prompt organisation and naturally generated notes together.
confounds.causal_or_measurement_path: Whole-workflow differences cannot identify isolated reasoning, notation or every EAL component.
confounds.control_or_adjustment: Cross donors with every task; retain all inputs and notes; analyse primary whole-workflow profiles and separate cloned-donor component contrasts.
confounds.diagnostic: Exact snapshots, recipient tool masks, initial/later prompts, matched task/configuration cells, component checks and annotation coverage.
confounds.residual_risk: No population, human or pure reasoning claim. Two new cases are not independently authored confirmation.

confounds.description: Answer-format and automatic annotation coverage can vary by condition/model.
confounds.causal_or_measurement_path: Reporting burden can change the answer, and limited parsing can change its measured score without a task error.
confounds.control_or_adjustment: Primary prose answers; record format separately; pending classifications remain unknown; blind manual review; separate three-mode diagnostic.
confounds.diagnostic: Pending fraction and format compliance by condition; masked audit of automatic labels; decision contrasts before/after documented annotation.
confounds.residual_risk: Manual coding can still infer treatment from content; small diagnostic samples do not establish format invariance.

estimands.population_or_system: Pinned GPT-4.1 nano and GPT-5 nano configurations on eight selected synthetic threshold cases; diagnostic component contrasts use two declared cases.
estimands.comparator: A fresh ordinary prompt session with the task specification and the latest complete answer naturally retained from earlier sessions as a project note; no supplied runbook, curated tool cache or previous conversation.
estimands.time: Initial and each of two subsequent new sessions; cumulative resources.
estimands.summary_measure: Task-decision agreement per planned session; within-case differences; optional basis/citation/format dimensions; initial, marginal recipient and cumulative tokens/cost/time; unknown bounds.
estimands.interpretation: Fixed-case whole-workflow profiles under a validated task formalisation. Different prompt contents are part of the intended treatment. Calls and sessions are not independent cases.

estimands.population_or_system: The declared two-case diagnostic subset with one donor configuration, both recipients and disabled native tools.
estimands.intervention_or_exposure: One declared component variant on a cloned donor state.
estimands.comparator: Its paired baseline variant with the same donor snapshot and fixed fixture.
estimands.time: One fresh recipient session per variant; donor preparation counted once separately.
estimands.summary_measure: Per-block paired task decisions and initial/shared versus marginal recipient resources; manipulation validity and annotation completeness.
estimands.interpretation: Exploratory component sensitivity under inspected manipulations. Directional patterns motivate further testing; small samples cannot establish equivalence, unique mechanism or population effects.

identification.causal_and_measurement_structure: Primary workflow changes source/host computation, evidence availability, prompt organisation and persisted artefacts together; observed decision and resource differences describe that package. Diagnostics copy one donor state and hold current fixture/facts fixed while varying a declared component. Raw answer -> arm/oracle-independent annotation -> independent task reference -> decision agreement. Pending annotation or incomplete execution leaves bounded task rates.
identified_parameters: Observed fixed-case decision/resource profiles where annotation and usage are known.
Best/worst task-completion bounds with pending or unobserved decisions.
Descriptive paired component differences where all declared manipulation checks pass.
nonidentified_alternatives: Primary workflow differences cannot identify isolated notation, native reasoning or individual host mechanisms.
Ties with small samples do not establish equivalence or absence of a reporting/notes effect.
Model-family versus dedicated-reasoning effects remain confounded.
Pre-authored arguments do not identify source-authoring effort or real developer productivity.
threats: Incorrect task formalisation or source meaning.
Missing meaning or qualification in model context.
Unequal donor states or external facts in component comparisons.
Condition-dependent annotation errors or post-outcome exclusions.
Incomplete usage and undercounted initial/shared setup.
diagnostics: Blind answer annotation/audit and coverage reporting.
Full allocation, raw records and separate resource paths.
rescue_actions: Keep invalid contrasts and pending outcomes, then repair the instrument or complete blind annotation before interpreting affected comparisons.
Use independently authored broader tasks and an information-based design for later confirmation.

sampling.method: Primary purposive eight-case crossed design with two executions per configuration. Diagnostics use two declared cases and both recipient models; one donor per block and one independent recipient per variant.
sampling.sample_size_or_information_target: Primary: 256 sequences, 768 sessions, at most 2304 requests. Separate diagnostics: four donor blocks, 32 total sessions, at most 96 requests.
inputs: Two repetitions and two recipient sessions
sampling.dependence_structure: Case clusters recur across arms, repetitions and sessions; no independent-sample count based on calls.
sampling.multiplicity: All descriptive contrasts retained; no tests, confidence intervals or significance claims.
sampling.attrition_or_loss: Retain every planned unit. Empty/failed responses are observed no-answer; unobserved or ambiguously annotated decisions remain unknown.
sampling.result: Coverage of selected workflows and diagnostic pathways; insufficient precision for population or equivalence inference. A single binary pair changes by -1, 0 or +1, so a small number of pairs has coarse resolution.
sampling.sensitivity_analysis: Report task decision separately from optional basis/citations/format; inspect blind annotation revisions; bound pending outcomes and missing sessions. Inspect each diagnostic factor separately.
sampling.stopping_implications: Stop on invalid calibration, fatal access/snapshot/budget failure, or external 120-minute job ceiling. Partial results remain partial.

analysis.preprocessing_lock: Save protocol, plan, task definitions, allocation and code identities before live observations. Preserve raw answers. Predeclare annotation rules, pending cases and blind annotation interface; record every later coding revision separately.
analysis.exclusion_lock: No post-scheduling omissions or replacement of failed units.

models.model_or_procedure: Independent annotation and task-reference scoring, separate cohort/session summaries, matched within-case differences, explicit pending/unobserved bounds and complete resource accounting.
diagnostics: Conservative annotation and masked manual audit
Zero/nonzero paired arithmetic and pending-label bounds

models.model_or_procedure: Within-donor one-factor recipient contrasts, condition on predeclared manipulation validity for attribution while retaining every raw unit and resource; report no pooled mechanism estimate.
assumptions: Identical donor/fixture state and equal current task facts except the declared intervention
Valid independent annotation and complete request accounting where resources are compared
diagnostics: Assigned-versus-delivered variant and actual collector counts
Clone independence and pending annotation coverage

contrasts: Primary EAL minus ordinary within case, donor, receiver, tools, repetition and session; initial and cumulative resources as well as later marginal resources.
Separate diagnostics: compact versus full; notes omitted versus included; prose versus prompted JSON and prompted versus schema JSON; compatible reuse versus forced collection.
analysis.uncertainty: Fixed-case paired differences and observed ranges without population intervals. Task rates retain best/worst bounds for pending/unobserved decisions. No-discordance diagnostic pairs do not establish equivalence.
analysis.multiplicity: Exploratory descriptive reporting of all specified cells and contrasts.
analysis.missing_data: Empty or absent attempted answers are observed no-answer. Unobserved sessions, ambiguous/contradictory text and unparseable JSON remain unknown pending annotation. Unknown usage blocks finite cost-per-correct-answer claims.
analysis.stopping_rule: Fixed plan with at most three requests per session, 4096 output tokens, 32768 request bytes, 90-second request timeout and USD 2 reservation ledger; manual workflow has a 120-minute ceiling.
robustness_checks: Separate diagnostic/additional primary cases, model transitions and session indices.
Report decision, optional basis/citations, false assertions, abstention, format and annotation coverage separately.
Audit all automatic labels with blind export when coding sensitivity could change interpretation.
Count host/native paths, initial preparation and cumulative work.
Inspect each diagnostic factor and any failed manipulation without pooling into the primary comparison.
software_and_versions: Python >=3.11; EAL/2; protocol 3.0.0; primary plan/report /3; diagnostic plan /1; Git identity and exact package/context versions recorded per run.
analysis.inconclusive_handling: Invalid task/source correspondence blocks calls. Partial execution, unresolved annotation, failed manipulation or conflicting outcomes remain explicitly inconclusive for the affected comparison.

decision_matrix.observation_region: Primary calibration passes, all planned observations and decision annotations are complete, and resources are known.
decision_matrix.decision_rule: Describe observed task and resource trade-offs including losses/ties; a lower cumulative token/cost total with preserved recorded task success is a bounded observed workflow advantage, not a population claim.

claim_effects.rationale: Replace conjectured profiles with recorded fixed-case differences.
claim_effects.scope_limit: Pinned GPT-4.1 nano and GPT-5 nano configurations on eight selected synthetic threshold cases; diagnostic component contrasts use two declared cases.

hypothesis_effects: The primary whole-workflow result does not distinguish the diagnostic hypothesis packages.
decision_matrix.assumption_failure_response: A failed instrument check overrides outcome interpretation.
decision_matrix.next_action: Select independently authored tasks targeting remaining uncertainties.

decision_matrix.observation_region: Task/source/context calibration fails before API collection.
decision_matrix.decision_rule: Record invalid task formalisation or information delivery and send zero API requests.

claim_effects.rationale: An inadequate measurement path cannot support the comparison.
claim_effects.scope_limit: Pinned GPT-4.1 nano and GPT-5 nano configurations on eight selected synthetic threshold cases; diagnostic component contrasts use two declared cases.

hypothesis_effects: The primary whole-workflow result does not distinguish the diagnostic hypothesis packages.
decision_matrix.assumption_failure_response: Repair and verify correspondence before a fresh run.
decision_matrix.next_action: Keep the failed calibration record and use a new output directory.

decision_matrix.observation_region: Calibration passes but primary execution, annotation or resource observation is incomplete, or an unanticipated instrument problem appears.
decision_matrix.decision_rule: Report coverage, pending decisions and bounds; do not replace unknown decisions with failed tasks or claim a completed comparison.

claim_effects.rationale: Missing or invalid data leave the comparison unresolved.
claim_effects.scope_limit: Pinned GPT-4.1 nano and GPT-5 nano configurations on eight selected synthetic threshold cases; diagnostic component contrasts use two declared cases.

hypothesis_effects: The primary whole-workflow result does not distinguish the diagnostic hypothesis packages.
decision_matrix.assumption_failure_response: Identify the failure and retain all attempts.
decision_matrix.next_action: Correct the identified cause before any new declared run.

decision_matrix.observation_region: Diagnostic state/fact/manipulation checks pass and an observed decision/resource pattern differs in a predicted direction.
decision_matrix.decision_rule: Report factor-specific observations and which rival packages they are more consistent with; retain stochastic uncertainty and avoid unique-mechanism or population claims.

claim_effects.rationale: Interpretation follows observed variation and the validity of the declared manipulation.
claim_effects.scope_limit: Declared diagnostic cases, snapshots, donor states and variants only.

hypothesis_effects: H-001/H-002: presentation sensitivity; H-003/H-004: stale-note sensitivity; H-005/H-006: reporting sensitivity; no package is confirmed by this small exploratory diagnostic.
decision_matrix.assumption_failure_response: Failed correspondence, annotation or manipulation overrides any favourable directional pattern.
decision_matrix.next_action: Design repeated independent diagnostic blocks targeting the observed sensitivity.

decision_matrix.observation_region: Diagnostic checks pass but outcomes tie, remain ambiguous, vary inconsistently or show a pattern shared by the rival packages.
decision_matrix.decision_rule: Report non-discrimination. Ties do not establish invariance or rule out a format/notes/presentation effect.

claim_effects.rationale: Interpretation follows observed variation and the validity of the declared manipulation.
claim_effects.scope_limit: Declared diagnostic cases, snapshots, donor states and variants only.

hypothesis_effects: H-001/H-002: presentation sensitivity; H-003/H-004: stale-note sensitivity; H-005/H-006: reporting sensitivity; no package is confirmed by this small exploratory diagnostic.
decision_matrix.assumption_failure_response: Failed correspondence, annotation or manipulation overrides any favourable directional pattern.
decision_matrix.next_action: Choose more diagnostic cases or additional independent blocks with a specified information target.

decision_matrix.observation_region: A diagnostic donor/fixture/fact-equality or delivery check fails.
decision_matrix.decision_rule: Retain every variant and its cost; mark the affected contrast invalid for component attribution.

claim_effects.rationale: Interpretation follows observed variation and the validity of the declared manipulation.
claim_effects.scope_limit: Declared diagnostic cases, snapshots, donor states and variants only.

hypothesis_effects: H-001/H-002: presentation sensitivity; H-003/H-004: stale-note sensitivity; H-005/H-006: reporting sensitivity; no package is confirmed by this small exploratory diagnostic.
decision_matrix.assumption_failure_response: Failed correspondence, annotation or manipulation overrides any favourable directional pattern.
decision_matrix.next_action: Repair the specific state or delivery defect and use a new run directory.

risks.mechanism: Selected simple tasks and models, plus repairs informed by earlier outcomes, limit generalisation.
risks.prevention: Separate diagnostic and additional cohorts and label all findings exploratory.
risks.sensitivity_or_correction: Independent future tasks and reference review are required for confirmation.
risks.residual_risk: No general engineering, human or model-class claim.

researcher_degrees_of_freedom: Six cases are diagnostic material informed by a historical run; two additional cases are not independently authored confirmation.
The plan fixes cases, models, repetitions, session structure, response mode, prompts and resource bounds before live responses.
Manual annotations remain linked to raw answers; revisions are retained without replacing original records.
Diagnostic factors, eligible cases, stale-note content and state/fact checks are specified before their responses.
negative_controls: Missing measurement cannot become a measured negative; an ended assumption cannot become ready.
positive_controls: Positive and negative computed threshold results, inclusive threshold boundaries.
falsification_checks: Changed claim meaning remains visible and invalid task/source meaning is rejected.
Reversed threshold direction, wrong threshold/scope, missing measurement and exact time boundaries.
Current negative result with and without the declared dated positive note.
Identical donor state before every diagnostic recipient and unchanged external fixture.
Ambiguous or contradictory text remains pending rather than forced into a convenient task label.
reporting_controls: All planned units, attempts and separate measurement dimensions retained.
residual_limitations: Pre-authored EAL and excluded authoring costs
Automatic annotation coverage and possible content-based unblinding
One execution per diagnostic variant and no independent confirmatory task sample

ethics_and_safety.rationale: Synthetic project data and read-only local fixture collectors; no human participants.
mitigations: Do not record headers or credential values; collector inherits no provider environment.
Reserve cost before requests; no hidden retries.
monitoring: Append-only request journal and resource ceilings.
stopping_rules: Access failure, snapshot mismatch, unavailable model, quota or budget limit.
post_stop_actions: Retain attempts and incomplete-run report without spending on replacement models.

apparatus_or_data: Implemented primary runner, independent references, eight task cases and conservative/manual annotation interfaces
Separate cloned-donor diagnostics and manual workflow with existing OPENAI_API_KEY secret
feasibility.access: The previously used snapshots must be checked at execution. Primary prose requires no provider JSON-schema capability; schema diagnostics require the declared serving-interface support.
skills: Existing EAL implementation and provider adapter
resources: USD 2 maximum estimated API reservation budget per run
dependencies: Credentialed manual execution of the selected branch/plan
feasibility.fallback: Retain calibration or blocked/partial status accurately; no fabricated live results.

reproducibility.registration: Versioned prospective exploratory protocol; no external preregistration claimed.
immutable_materials: Per-run protocol, plan, cases, assignments, code identity, API journal, raw answers, project notes and EAL state.
Diagnostic pristine donor snapshots, cloned-state fingerprints, intervention manifests and manipulation checks.
Blind annotation items, separate mapping, attributed code decisions/quotes/reasons and derived annotated rows.
reproducibility.data_plan: Preserve raw runs and code annotations separately; write new derived rows/reports without overwriting originals. Workflow artefacts retained for 90 days subject to repository limits; archive important evidence before expiry.
reproducibility.code_plan: Existing Git repository and PR; no automatic workflow trigger.
reproducibility.randomisation_or_seed_plan: Seed 20260928 for primary matched-block/arm ordering and declared diagnostic order. Separate requests remain stochastic; no deterministic provider seed claim.
reproducibility.provenance_plan: Snapshot protocol and fixture definitions; record Git revision, dirty state, implementation hashes, models, pricing, prompts, attempts and timestamps.
reproducibility.deviation_and_amendment_plan: New protocol version and output directory for changes; preserve prior raw data and scores.
reproducibility.replication_plan: Repeat under declared resources and evaluate independently authored broader tasks before confirmation.

sources: User goal: reliable economical knowledge reuse across new sessions/models
Official OpenAI structured-output and reasoning contracts
change_log: 3.0.0: whole-workflow task-decision comparison, compact checked task context, prose/manual annotation and separate cloned-donor component diagnostics.

method_selection.rationale: Validate task formalisation and answer measurement, describe practical workflow decisions/resources, and use separate controlled component perturbations to generate candidate explanations.
method_selection.inference_framework: Primary fixed-case descriptive comparison; separate exploratory mechanism discrimination with explicit rival packages and manipulation checks. Pending measurements yield bounds; no significance, equivalence or population inference.
alternatives_considered: A human study measures same/different-developer effort and source authoring; this automated investigation cannot substitute for it.
Identical prompts would constrain a workflow whose purpose includes reducing repeated input; use the same task with workflow-appropriate prompts.
A curated runbook/tool-cache comparator changes the requested ordinary new-session practice; equal-fact comparisons are confined to component diagnostics.
Mandatory JSON gives convenient automatic scoring but can alter task behaviour; use prose and separate annotation, with JSON as a diagnostic intervention.
Independent donor sessions serve the whole-workflow comparison; copied donor states are required to isolate a recipient component.

sources.citation: John W. Tukey (1980), We Need Both Exploratory and Confirmatory, The American Statistician 34, 23-25.
sources.design_consequence: Keep this exploratory pilot separate from an independent confirmatory study.

sources.citation: Cronbach, L. J. and Meehl, P. E. (1955), Construct validity in psychological tests, Psychological Bulletin 52, 281–302.
sources.design_consequence: Validate the intended answer-quality measurement and separate format/file side effects from its interpretation.

sources.citation: John R. Platt (1964), Strong Inference, Science 146, 347-353.
sources.design_consequence: State rival diagnostic explanations and vary one component on a common donor state; shared or sparse outcomes remain non-discriminating.

method_selection.information_criterion: Primary coverage: eight cases crossed over donor/recipient/tools, two later positions and two repetitions. Diagnostics: inspect the predicted direction and validity of each component contrast, without claiming adequate precision for equivalence or stable effect sizes.
permitted_conclusions: Observed task-decision and initial/subsequent/cumulative resource profiles in the executed primary configurations.
Specific task-formalisation, interface, annotation or manipulation defects.
Exploratory component sensitivity where cloned-state and fact checks pass.
excluded_conclusions: Human developer productivity or authoring efficiency
General EAL superiority or model-class effect
Pure reasoning, notation or intrinsic tool-capability effect
Equivalence from tied small-sample results or unique mechanism from a workflow advantage
method_selection.discovery_confirmation_separation: Six cases remain diagnostic; two additional cases are prospective but not independently authored. Confirmation requires independently selected tasks.

assignment.procedure: Cross eight cases, two donor models, two receiver models, two native-tool settings, two repetitions and ordinary/EAL arms. Shuffle matched blocks and arm order using seed 20260928.
assignment.failure_response: Retain the affected unit and failure; suspend invalid measurements rather than silently deleting them.

collection.procedure: Fresh sessions with workflow-specific prompts and ordinary prose; persist the latest complete unmodified answer as a project note under the common size limit. For diagnostics clone a donor state and change one recipient factor; retain starts, responses and actual manipulations.
collection.artifact: provider.BudgetedClient; session.SessionRunner; project.Project; conditions; journal.AttemptJournal; diagnostics.DiagnosticPilot
collection.failure_response: Retain the affected unit and failure; suspend invalid measurements rather than silently deleting them.

scoring.procedure: Annotate expressed decisions independently of the oracle; retain ambiguous labels, export/import blind manual codes, then compare with independent reference arithmetic. Optional basis/citation/format dimensions stay separate.
scoring.failure_response: Retain the affected unit and failure; suspend invalid measurements rather than silently deleting them.

analysis.procedure: Report primary matched task-decision/resource profiles, pending bounds and cumulative resources; report diagnostic one-factor differences and invalid manipulations separately.
analysis.failure_response: Retain the affected unit and failure; suspend invalid measurements rather than silently deleting them.

verification.case: Primary crossed allocation and diagnostic cloned-state allocation
verification.expected_result: 256 unique primary sequences; declared diagnostic blocks/variants with no missing or duplicate assignments.
verification.observed_result: Crossed primary allocation and all four diagnostic donor blocks/28 recipient variants pass allocation and tamper checks.

verification.case: Actual source/task calibration, fresh messages, raw-note persistence, tool masks and interrupted requests
verification.expected_result: Task distinctions survive runtime/context; invalid sources fail before API; every planned unit and unknown resource retained.
verification.observed_result: CLI calibration passed 40 primary and 20 diagnostic checks with zero API requests. Collection, incomplete-response retention, fresh-message and handoff regressions pass.

verification.case: Natural prose, negation, ambiguity, malformed JSON, separate secondary dimensions and blind annotation
verification.expected_result: Known task decisions survive incidental reporting differences; ambiguous text remains pending; imported codes are linked to unchanged raw answers without oracle exposure.
verification.observed_result: 32 dedicated answer/annotation tests pass, including interrogatives, retractions, pending prose and blind annotation; incomplete provider text remains separately codable.

verification.case: Known paired effects, pending-label bounds, initial/later/cumulative accounting and incomplete usage
verification.expected_result: Correct paired signs and denominators; unknown outcomes/resources distinct from failures/zero; shared diagnostic donor counted once.
verification.observed_result: Cumulative overhead arithmetic, unknown outcome bounds, missing sessions and missing token breakdowns pass; diagnostic donor resources count once.

verification.case: Scripted primary and diagnostic pipelines with actual EAL and manual-annotation roundtrip
verification.expected_result: Complete retained assignments/raw responses/reports; one-factor checks and offline reconstruction work without making an empirical model claim.
verification.observed_result: Scripted primary rehearsal retains 32 sequences/96 sessions; diagnostic rehearsal retains four donors/28 recipients. Both support derived annotations and offline analysis without overwriting raw rows.

verification.case: Clone equality, fixture and fact fingerprints, one-factor manipulation and tamper detection
verification.expected_result: Valid component contrasts pass; state/fact/delivery defects remain visible and invalidate attribution.
verification.observed_result: Clone, fixture, fact and delivered-factor checks pass; deliberate manipulation/state defects invalidate component attribution.

verification.expected_result: Pinned configurations produce actual task answers and usage under the selected primary or diagnostic plan.
